drd_row.transformation:
If there is a record in CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP table with TXN.TXN_ID = TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID
and TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 (Cancel)
and TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID
then set to 'Y' for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID.

The check should be performed each time when a new record is written into CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP with TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID = 69 and update the flag for both TRGT_TXN_ID and SRC_TXN_ID, if TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID.

Note: TXN_RLTNP.TRGT_TXN_ID <> TXN_RLTNP.SRC_TXN_ID is needed because it is possible that cancellation trade points to itself when the original trade that is being cancelled is not found. In this case Cancelled Flag should not be set to 'Y'

    ON OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD field. LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V e ON e.Entity_code_long = OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD AND t.td >= e.EFF_DT AND t.td < e.END_DT AND e.ENTITY_RECYCLED_BOOLEAN='0' AND e.ENTITY_FINANCIAL_RIA_BOOLEAN = '0'

    ON t.src_stm_id = ss.src_stm_id

    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_st_id and cv.CL_SCM_ID = 12

    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ad ON AP.OFST_AR_ID = ad.AR_ID and t.td >= ad.EFF_DT and t.td < ad.END_DT

    ON jt.txn_id = t.txn_id

    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id

    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id

    ON ap.pd_id = ccpd.ccal_pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON ap.db_cr_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.CASH_POS_TP_DIM J18
    ON ap.CASH_POS_TP_ID = cptd.CASH_POS_TP_ID
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.IMT_PD_DIM J29
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join cird_owner.imt_pd_dim ipd ON ipd.CCAL_PD_ID = ap.PD_ID and ipd.eff_dt <= t.td and ipd.end_dt > t.td
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join cird_owner.ccy_dim cd ON cd.ccy_cd = ap.txn_iso_ccy_code
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.dol_ind_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '35'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.EXEC_SBTP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '6'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.EXEC_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '5'
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_RSN_TP_DIM J19
    ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_SRC_TP_DIM J20
    ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_MKT_TP_DIM J21
    ON lmtd.lgcy_mkt_tp_id = t.lgcy_mkt_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_TRD_CPCTY_TP_DIM J42
    ON t.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id = ltctd.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.txn t2 ON tr.trgt_txn_id = t2.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.src_stm_dim stm ON t2.src_stm_id = stm.src_stm_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP J32
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cl_val_id = tr.TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '4'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2507 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2506 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.sale_chrg_rate_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '73'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON this field is always null, so there is no need to expose this field in view.
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.ccal_cird_pd_map J43
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccpm on ccpm.ccal_pd_id = ap.pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.db_cr_id dci and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.DATE_DIM J27
    ON t.sd = dd.cal_dt
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_ENTR_CNL_TP_DIM J22
    ON t.src_entr_cnl_tp_id = sectd.src_entr_cnl_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_PCS_TP_DIM J23
    ON t.src_pcs_tp_id = sptd.src_pcs_tp_id
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
    ON ssd.src_stm_id = t.src_stm_id
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
    ON ap.stm_base_iso_ccy_code = cd.ccy_cd
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.TRD_SLCT_TP_DIM J24
    ON t.trd_slct_tp_id = tstd.trd_slct_tp_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_sbtp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '3'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '2'
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON the lookup for BKR_AR_ID
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join ccsi_repl_owner.ar_dim ard ON ard.AR_ID = ap.OFST_AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_SRC_TAX_CODE_LKUP J33
    ON TXN.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID = LKP.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID and LKP.ACTV_F = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_AVY_CL J17
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.NNA_CGY J34
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.net_new _ast_cgy nna ON nna.net_new_ast_cgy_id = tac.net_new_ast_cgy_id
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.SRC_BUY_SELL_MULTI_ID and cv.CL_SCM_ID = '99' (this is excessive; using cl_val_id no need to use CL_SCM. Added for consistency with existing Name attribute)
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE TBC if CDS values are to be left padded with 0 to 3
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY txn on apa.txn_iso_ccy_code = txn.CCY_CODE
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ar_dim on t.ar_id = ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v J44
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v2 on fa_number_v2.responsible_party_employee_id = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id and fa_number_v2.fa_number_type_code in ('pri','PRI') AND t.td >= fa_number_v2.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v2.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV J13
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV brk_own_psn on brk_own_psn.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V J35
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V brk_own_psn_brk_subdim on brk_own_psn_brk.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V J26
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date; JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V brk_own_resp_ams_disc on brk_own_resp_ams_disc.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_resp_ams_disc.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_resp_ams_disc.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V J6
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V J8
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V own_rtl_ent on own_rtl_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_rtl_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_rtl_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J45
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J46
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim J5
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
LEFT JOIN cird_owner.IMT_PD_DIM J9
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V J14
    ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V J47
    ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V CODE_SET_VALUE_V ON CODE_SET_VALUE_V.CODE_VALUE_ID = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE_ID And TXN.TD >= CODE_SET_VALUE_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < CODE_SET_VALUE_V.END_DATE

LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.SHDW_TXN_TP J36

LEFT JOIN REFERENCE_REPL_OWNER.IMPCT_ACTION_LKU J37
    ON t.src_actn_code = impct_action_lku.action_code
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.SRC_BUY_SELL_MULTI_ID and cv.CL_SCM_ID = '99'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cl_val.cl_val_id = t.SRC_CNCL_RSN_ID cs.cl_scm_id = '102'
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_GRP_SUBDIM J38
    ON t.AR_ID = fa.AR_ID and t.td >= fa.EFF_DT and t.td < fa.END_DT
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V J14
    ON OWN_FA_NUM field. left join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V fn on fn.FA_NUMBER = OWN_FA_NUM and t.td >= fn.EFF_DT AND t.td < fn.END_DT
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V J39
    ON OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD field. LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V e ON e.Entity_code_long = OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD AND t.td >= e.EFF_DT AND t.td < e.END_DT AND e.ENTITY_RECYCLED_BOOLEAN='0' AND e.ENTITY_FINANCIAL_RIA_BOOLEAN = '0'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.ACATS_BROKER J15
    ON b.broker_id = t.orig_src_stm_code and t.src_stm_id IN ( 53, 54 )
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON ard.AR_ID = t.AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
    ON t.src_stm_id = ss.src_stm_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_st_id and cv.CL_SCM_ID = 12
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ad ON AP.OFST_AR_ID = ad.AR_ID and t.td >= ad.EFF_DT and t.td < ad.END_DT
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.DATE_DIM J27
    ON t.td = dd.cal_dt
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.EXG_DIM J28
    ON ed.EXG_CD = t.exg_code
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.ACG_TP_DIM J16
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join common_owner.acg_tp_dim atd ON AP.ACG_TP_ID = atd.ACG_TP_ID
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.FIP J10
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join ccal_repl_owner.fip f ON f.apa_id = ap.apa_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.J$TXN J40
    ON jt.txn_id = t.txn_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.AVY_CL J11
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_AVY_CL J17
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CCAL_CIRD_PD_MAP J41
    ON ap.pd_id = ccpd.ccal_pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON ap.db_cr_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.CASH_POS_TP_DIM J18
    ON ap.CASH_POS_TP_ID = cptd.CASH_POS_TP_ID
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.IMT_PD_DIM J29
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join cird_owner.imt_pd_dim ipd ON ipd.CCAL_PD_ID = ap.PD_ID and ipd.eff_dt <= t.td and ipd.end_dt > t.td
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join cird_owner.ccy_dim cd ON cd.ccy_cd = ap.txn_iso_ccy_code
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.dol_ind_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '35'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.EXEC_SBTP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '6'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.EXEC_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '5'
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_RSN_TP_DIM J19
    ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_SRC_TP_DIM J20
    ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_MKT_TP_DIM J21
    ON lmtd.lgcy_mkt_tp_id = t.lgcy_mkt_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_TRD_CPCTY_TP_DIM J42
    ON t.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id = ltctd.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.txn t2 ON tr.trgt_txn_id = t2.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.src_stm_dim stm ON t2.src_stm_id = stm.src_stm_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP J32
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cl_val_id = tr.TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '4'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2507 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2506 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.sale_chrg_rate_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '73'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
    ON this field is always null, so there is no need to expose this field in view.
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.ccal_cird_pd_map J43
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccpm on ccpm.ccal_pd_id = ap.pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.db_cr_id dci and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.DATE_DIM J27
    ON t.sd = dd.cal_dt
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_ENTR_CNL_TP_DIM J22
    ON t.src_entr_cnl_tp_id = sectd.src_entr_cnl_tp_id
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_PCS_TP_DIM J23
    ON t.src_pcs_tp_id = sptd.src_pcs_tp_id
LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
    ON ssd.src_stm_id = t.src_stm_id
LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
    ON ap.stm_base_iso_ccy_code = cd.ccy_cd
LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.TRD_SLCT_TP_DIM J24
    ON t.trd_slct_tp_id = tstd.trd_slct_tp_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_sbtp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '3'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '2'
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON the lookup for BKR_AR_ID
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join ccsi_repl_owner.ar_dim ard ON ard.AR_ID = ap.OFST_AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_SRC_TAX_CODE_LKUP J33
    ON TXN.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID = LKP.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID and LKP.ACTV_F = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_AVY_CL J17
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.NNA_CGY J34
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.net_new _ast_cgy nna ON nna.net_new_ast_cgy_id = tac.net_new_ast_cgy_id
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
    ON cv.cl_val_id = t.SRC_BUY_SELL_MULTI_ID and cv.CL_SCM_ID = '99' (this is excessive; using cl_val_id no need to use CL_SCM. Added for consistency with existing Name attribute)
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE TBC if CDS values are to be left padded with 0 to 3
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE
LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY txn on apa.txn_iso_ccy_code = txn.CCY_CODE
LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ar_dim on t.ar_id = ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v J44
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v2 on fa_number_v2.responsible_party_employee_id = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id and fa_number_v2.fa_number_type_code in ('pri','PRI') AND t.td >= fa_number_v2.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v2.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV J13
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV brk_own_psn on brk_own_psn.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V J35
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V brk_own_psn_brk_subdim on brk_own_psn_brk.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V J26
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date; JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V brk_own_resp_ams_disc on brk_own_resp_ams_disc.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_resp_ams_disc.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_resp_ams_disc.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V J6
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V J8
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V own_rtl_ent on own_rtl_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_rtl_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_rtl_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J45
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J46
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
LEFT JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim J5
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
LEFT JOIN cird_owner.IMT_PD_DIM J9
    ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V J14
    ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE
LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V J47
    ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V CODE_SET_VALUE_V ON CODE_SET_VALUE_V.CODE_VALUE_ID = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE_ID And TXN.TD >= CODE_SET_VALUE_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < CODE_SET_VALUE_V.END_DATE;

    LEFT JOIN REFERENCE_REPL_OWNER.IMPCT_ACTION_LKU J37
        ON t.src_actn_code = impct_action_lku.action_code
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.SRC_BUY_SELL_MULTI_ID and cv.CL_SCM_ID = '99'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cl_val.cl_val_id = t.SRC_CNCL_RSN_ID cs.cl_scm_id = '102'
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_GRP_SUBDIM J38

        ON OWN_FA_NUM field. left join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V fn on fn.FA_NUMBER = OWN_FA_NUM and t.td >= fn.EFF_DT AND t.td < fn.END_DT
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V J39
        ON OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD field. LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V e ON e.Entity_code_long = OWN_FA_NUM_ENT_CD AND t.td >= e.EFF_DT AND t.td < e.END_DT AND e.ENTITY_RECYCLED_BOOLEAN='0' AND e.ENTITY_FINANCIAL_RIA_BOOLEAN = '0'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.ACATS_BROKER J15
        ON b.broker_id = t.orig_src_stm_code and t.src_stm_id IN ( 53, 54 )
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
        ON ard.AR_ID = t.AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
        ON t.src_stm_id = ss.src_stm_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_st_id and cv.CL_SCM_ID = 12
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ad ON AP.OFST_AR_ID = ad.AR_ID and t.td >= ad.EFF_DT and t.td < ad.END_DT
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.DATE_DIM J27
        ON t.td = dd.cal_dt
    LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.EXG_DIM J28
        ON ed.EXG_CD = t.exg_code
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.ACG_TP_DIM J16
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join common_owner.acg_tp_dim atd ON AP.ACG_TP_ID = atd.ACG_TP_ID
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.FIP J10
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join ccal_repl_owner.fip f ON f.apa_id = ap.apa_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.J$TXN J40
        ON jt.txn_id = t.txn_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.AVY_CL J11
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_AVY_CL J17
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CCAL_CIRD_PD_MAP J41
        ON ap.pd_id = ccpd.ccal_pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON ap.db_cr_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.CASH_POS_TP_DIM J18
        ON ap.CASH_POS_TP_ID = cptd.CASH_POS_TP_ID
    LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.IMT_PD_DIM J29
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join cird_owner.imt_pd_dim ipd ON ipd.CCAL_PD_ID = ap.PD_ID and ipd.eff_dt <= t.td and ipd.end_dt > t.td
    LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join cird_owner.ccy_dim cd ON cd.ccy_cd = ap.txn_iso_ccy_code
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON t.dol_ind_id = cv.cl_val_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '35'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON t.EXEC_SBTP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '6'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON t.EXEC_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '5'
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_RSN_TP_DIM J19
        ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_rsn_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_CNCL_CMPLN_SRC_TP_DIM J20
        ON ld.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id = t.lgcy_cncl_cmpln_src_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_MKT_TP_DIM J21
        ON lmtd.lgcy_mkt_tp_id = t.lgcy_mkt_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.LGCY_TRD_CPCTY_TP_DIM J42
        ON t.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id = ltctd.lgcy_trd_cpcty_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cv.cl_val_id = t.oms_exec_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '96'
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
        ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.txn t2 ON tr.trgt_txn_id = t2.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.src_stm_dim stm ON t2.src_stm_id = stm.src_stm_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_RLTNP J32
        ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON t.txn_id = tr.src_txn_id and tr.actv_f = 'Y' left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON cl_val_id = tr.TXN_RLTNP_TP_ID and cv.cl_scm_id = '4'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2507 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.cl_val cv ON AP.APA_TP_ID = cv.CL_VAL_ID AND CASE WHEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE_TP_ID = 2506 THEN AP.SALE_CHRG_RATE
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.sale_chrg_rate_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '73'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.APA J2
        ON this field is always null, so there is no need to expose this field in view.
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.ccal_cird_pd_map J43
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccpm on ccpm.ccal_pd_id = ap.pd_id and ccpm.actv_f = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = ap.db_cr_id dci and cv.cl_scm_id = '15'
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.DATE_DIM J27
        ON t.sd = dd.cal_dt
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_ENTR_CNL_TP_DIM J22
        ON t.src_entr_cnl_tp_id = sectd.src_entr_cnl_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.SRC_PCS_TP_DIM J23
        ON t.src_pcs_tp_id = sptd.src_pcs_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN COMMON_OWNER.SRC_STM_DIM J12
        ON ssd.src_stm_id = t.src_stm_id
    LEFT JOIN CIRD_OWNER.CCY_DIM J30
        ON ap.stm_base_iso_ccy_code = cd.ccy_cd
    LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS_OWNER.TRD_SLCT_TP_DIM J24
        ON t.trd_slct_tp_id = tstd.trd_slct_tp_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_sbtp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '3'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.txn_tp_id and cv.cl_scm_id = '2'
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
        ON the lookup for BKR_AR_ID
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.AR_DIM J7
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id LEFT join ccsi_repl_owner.ar_dim ard ON ard.AR_ID = ap.OFST_AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_SRC_TAX_CODE_LKUP J33
        ON TXN.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID = LKP.SRC_TAX_CODE_ID and LKP.ACTV_F = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.TXN_AVY_CL J17
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.avy_cl acl ON acl.avy_cl_id = tac.avy_cl_id
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.NNA_CGY J34
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id left join ccal_repl_owner.txn_avy_cl tac ON tac.txn_id = t.txn_id and tac.actv_f = 'Y' and ap.apa_id = tac.apa_id left join ccal_repl_owner.net_new _ast_cgy nna ON nna.net_new_ast_cgy_id = tac.net_new_ast_cgy_id
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
    LEFT JOIN CCAL_REPL_OWNER.CL_VAL J3
        ON cv.cl_val_id = t.SRC_BUY_SELL_MULTI_ID and cv.CL_SCM_ID = '99' (this is excessive; using cl_val_id no need to use CL_SCM. Added for consistency with existing Name attribute)
    LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE TBC if CDS values are to be left padded with 0 to 3
    LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY orig on apa.orig_ccy_id = orig.CCY_ISO_NUM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN Reference_Repl_Owner.CCY J25
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join REFERENCE_repl_OWNER.CCY txn on apa.txn_iso_ccy_code = txn.CCY_CODE
    LEFT JOIN CCSI_OWNER.ar_dim J4
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id join ccsi_owner.ar_dim ar_dim on t.ar_id = ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt
    LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v J44
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v2 on fa_number_v2.responsible_party_employee_id = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id and fa_number_v2.fa_number_type_code in ('pri','PRI') AND t.td >= fa_number_v2.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v2.end_date
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV J13
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_RV brk_own_psn on brk_own_psn.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
    LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V J35
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date JOIN ssds_dal_owner.PERSON_BROKERAGE_SUBDIMENSION_V brk_own_psn_brk_subdim on brk_own_psn_brk.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_psn.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_psn.end_date
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V J26
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date; JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.PERSON_AMS_DISCRETIONARY_STATUS_V brk_own_resp_ams_disc on brk_own_resp_ams_disc.EMPLOYEE_ID = fa_number_v1.responsible_party_employee_id AND t.td >= brk_own_resp_ams_disc.effective_date AND t.td < brk_own_resp_ams_disc.end_date
    LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V J6
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0
    LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V J8
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RETAIL_DIMENSION_V own_rtl_ent on own_rtl_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_rtl_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_rtl_ent.end_date
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J45
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
    LEFT JOIN ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIM J46
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccsi_owner.ar_grp_subdim ar_grp_subdim ON ar_grp_subdim.ar_id = t.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_grp_subdim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_grp_subdim.end_dt join ccsi_owner.ar_dim bkr_ar_dim on ar_grp_subdim.linked_bkr_ar_id = bkr_ar_dim.ar_id AND t.td >= ar_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < ar_dim.end_dt JOIN ssds_dal_owner.fa_number_v fa_number_v1 ON UPPER(TRIM((bkr_ar_dim.own_bsn_ent_cd) = fa_number_v1.fa_number AND t.td >= fa_number_v1.effective_date AND t.td < fa_number_v1.end_date Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_DIM_V own_fa_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_code_long = fa_number_v1.fa_number_entity_code AND t.td >= own_fa_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_fa_ent.end_date AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_recycled_boolean = 0 AND brk_own_fa_ent.entity_financial_ria_boolean = 0 Join ssds_dal_owner.ENTERPRISE_ENTITY_RISK_DIMENSION_V own_risk_ent on own_fa_ent.entity_enterprise_id = own_risk_ent.entity_enterprise_id AND t.td >= own_risk_ent.effective_date AND t.td < own_risk_ent.end_date
    LEFT JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim J5
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
    LEFT JOIN cird_owner.IMT_PD_DIM J9
        ON ap.exec_id = t.txn_id JOIN ccal_repl_owner.ccal_cird_pd_map ccal_cird_pd_map on ON ap.pd_id = ccal_cird_pd_map.ccal_pd_id ND ccal_cird_pd_map.actv_f = 'Y' JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim1 on ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim1.cird_pd_id (-- cird_pd-based dimension (only used when src_stm_id = 93)) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim1.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim1.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim ON ap.pd_id = imt_pd_dim.ccal_pd_id (ccal_pd-based dimension) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim.end_dt JOIN cird_owner.imt_pd_dim imt_pd_dim_cird ON ccal_cird_pd_map.cird_pd_id = imt_pd_dim_cird.cird_pd_id (Dimension via mapped cird_pd) AND t.td >= imt_pd_dim_cird.eff_dt AND t.td < imt_pd_dim_cird.end_dt
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V J14
        ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE
    LEFT JOIN SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V J47
        ON TXN.AR_ID = AR_GRP_SUBDIM.AR_ID And TXN.TD >= AR_GRP_SUBDIM.EFF_DT And TXN.TD < AR_GRP_SUBDIM.END_DT Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.FA_NUMBER_V FA_NUMBER_V ON AR_GRP_SUBDIM.FA_NUM = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER And TXN.TD >= FA_NUMBER_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < FA_NUMBER_V.END_DATE Left Join SSDS_DAL_OWNER.CODE_SET_VALUE_V CODE_SET_VALUE_V ON CODE_SET_VALUE_V.CODE_VALUE_ID = FA_NUMBER_V.FA_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE_ID And TXN.TD >= CODE_SET_VALUE_V.EFFECTIVE_DATE And TXN.TD < CODE_SET_VALUE_V.END_DATE
)

    LEFT JOIN cird_owner.IMT_PD_DIM J9

ard.AR_ID = t.AR_ID and ard.eff_dt <= t.td and ard.end_dt > t.td
